critical_code_review_comments: DrawingStyleBar.jsx: outer flex justify-center wrapper + inner tp-fade-up cleanly fixes the previous right-side-then-centre jump caused by combining -translate-x-1/2 with the transform-based fade animation.
pointer-events-none on wrapper with pointer-events-auto only on the inner bar correctly preserves chart pan on empty gutter areas.
data-chart-overlay=1 on both wrapper and bar plus DrawingLayer.onDown early-return prevents deselection when interacting with bar buttons - verified.
Minor: draw-line-pop uses left-1/2 -ml-[86px] centred under the LINE button; at 390px viewport it still fits, but consider a viewport-edge clamp if narrower devices are supported.
test_credentials: qa.draw.tester2@binaryfundglobal.com JWT from /app/memory/test_credentials.md injected via localStorage.bfg_token
seed_data_creation: Created transient trend_line drawings on QA account during testing; deleted through the style bar. A single leftover drawing may remain from the desktop reselect flow (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: On mobile the rail is hidden behind data-testid=mobile-chart-tools; click that first to reveal rail-drawing. Desktop uses desk-rail-drawing directly. Inject JWT after goto('/'), then goto('/demo-trade').
rca of the issue: Two root causes were fixed: (1) DrawingLayer.onDown ran hit-testing on all pointerdown events including presses on the floating bar, deselecting the drawing and unmounting the bar - fixed with an early return when e.target.closest('[data-chart-overlay]'). (2) The old bar used absolute left-1/2 with -translate-x-1/2, which conflicted with the tp-fade-up transform animation and produced an initial right-side position that snapped to centre - fixed by moving centring to an outer flex justify-center wrapper so the transform on the inner bar no longer affects horizontal placement. Both fixes verified by pixel-accurate bbox measurements (offset=0.0) and by mounting persistence checks across all bar buttons.
